# Changelog

All notable changes to The Canonical Shelf, newest first. Entries come from `.roa/records`.

## 2026-09-25

### Milestones

- Phase 0 done: Merge single-page app (PR #27)
- Phase 1a done: Hygiene and data fixes

### Decided

- Offline access is not a requirement
- Primary learner is a graduate-level adult who recently came to faith; also casual adults and existing Christians or study groups
- Do not show the tool to the primary learner until the core surfaces are visually polished
- Project state is managed with project-roa-kit: append-only records compiled into agent state and human docs

### Added

- Bible reader cross-references from OpenBible.info (182k links), built in CI
- Light and dark modes with five scholarly theme variations
- Project state, changelog, status, decision log, and agent guide generated by project-roa-kit

### Changed

- One masthead and navigation model across pages

### Removed

- Where to start reader module
- Stale 140-file backup folder and restoration flag from the repository

### Fixed

- Glossary shows 44 terms as English instead of code identifiers
- Home shelf spines fill the shelf in proportion to chapter count

## 2026-09-24

### Decided

- The app is a single-page application: one document, History API routing, native DOM templates (supersedes document-first-routing)

### Changed

- Restored the single-page architecture with DOM templates

## 2026-09-22
